packet.title: Kotlin: XQuery, XSLT, XSD and resource data (implementation, here)
packet.summary: Adds compileQuery, compileStylesheet and compileSchema to the Kotlin binding over side results, and ships the DUCET as a Java class path resource.

body.p: (): compileQuery, compileStylesheet, compileSchema over the side results, seven JNI entry points, the DUCET class path resource, bindings/kotlin/README.md; kotlin/jvm 65 tests (25 of full.test.ts), 0 leaks with LeakSanitizer on; the host shim refuses U+0000. The examples above serialize by the text method (the JSON method raised SERE0023 on two items). After . Owns the Kotlin and glue files for compileQuery, compileStylesheet and compileSchema: side results, UpdateSink, Message, TransformResult and ValidationResult. It also adds the DUCET as a Java resource (dev/tinyactors/sxml/allkeys.txt, copied from third_party/unicode-collation/allkeys.txt by the build) and CollationData. Done when kotlin/jvm passes the whole parity list (full.test.ts included) with 0 leaks. Golden: sxml_javascript_xquery.c and its TypeScript counterpart.
